name: ai-vendor-onboarding-packet
title: AI Vendor Onboarding Packet
description: Risk-classify an AI vendor against the EU AI Act, pull the matching Model Contractual AI Clauses, assemble the Common Paper AI Addendum from Cover Page Key Terms, confirm the DPA is GDPR Art 28 complete, and emit a countersigned agent-acceptance receipt. End-to-end verifiable AI-vendor onboarding.

steps.handoff: high-risk verdict normalizes to a risk_tier (high-risk unless out-of-scope) feeding the clause mapper
MCC-AI template + applicable Chapter III clauses inform the addendum's Cover Page Key Terms
assembled AI Addendum + contract-api.json feed the DPA completeness check
Art 28(3) completeness verdict feeds the agent-countersign step
Exports a countersigned agent-acceptance receipt, hash-chained to the assembled addendum -- final stage
